title: Computing bounded solutions to linear Diophantine equations with the sum of divisors
summary: We propose an efficient computational method for finding all solutions $n\leq U$ to the Diophantine equation $aσ(n)=bn+c$, where $a,b,c$ are fixed integer coefficients, $U$ is a given upper bound, and $σ(n)$ denotes the sum of divisors of $n$. The method combines advanced pruning of possible prime factors of $n$ and their combinations with several optimization techniques, organized around a \emph{prime-wheel} data structure developed for this purpose.
